en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Azramy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
’ Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was wearing rings in his<sup>asws</sup> right hand’.
en.sarwar: 16. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from al-‘Arzamiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
’Amir al-Mu’minin would wear the ring on his right hand.’”
